title: Hold a licence to operate a cemetery or crematorium
what: Operate a cemetery or crematorium only as the licensee of the facility.

sources.title: Cemeteries and Crematoria Act 2020 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 45 (current republication (R8, from 5 September 2026; Cemeteries and Crematoria Act 2020 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person operates a facility; and (b) the person is not the licensee of the facility
